Saint Luke the Evangelist - feast day, October 18.

Today, October 18th, we remember Saint Luke the Evangelist, the beloved physician who wrote the Third Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles. Saint Luke, pray for us.

Please follow and help us grow support for Saint Charbel.

Sources: Vatican News, Saint of the Day, October 18. Art: panel by Juan Rexach (15th century), public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

Saints John de Brébeuf, Isaac Jogues and Companions - feast day, October 19.

Today, October 19th, we remember Saints John de Brébeuf, Isaac Jogues and their Companions, Jesuit missionaries who gave their lives bringing the Gospel to the peoples of New France. Holy Canadian Martyrs, pray for us.

Please follow and help us grow support for Saint Charbel.

Sources: Vatican News, Saint of the Day, October 19. Art: stained-glass window of the North American Martyrs, St. John’s Church, Omaha; photo by Workman, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
